notes: S2/F68 (Z1; §5.5.2: the chain is evaluated in the listed order and the first failing check decides): the note citing the depth-9 grant (nine parent links, one beyond the bound) is recorded at T4, and the root grant is revoked by a valid revocation effective at T2. Step 6 judges the cited grant and every ancestor, so the revoked root, which lies beyond the depth bound, is found before step 7, so the record is unverifiable E_GRANT_REVOKED, not E_GRANT_UNRESOLVED.
